method: tools/delta_map.py. HW1 side: Relic's source at GoK root commit ad1bb82 (gitlab archive of ad1bb82ca3c62dcc8be9d35f2e836d0bb7cf7caa, src/{Game,Win32,Ships,SinglePlayer}); each unit run through cpp -DHW_Release -DWIN32 -D_WIN32 -D_X86_ -D_MSC_VER=1100 -D_M_IX86=600 -D__MSC__=yes -DHW_English -D_MT with a case-insensitive include dir (system headers stubbed), so debug-only code is compiled out as in a retail build and macros are expanded; definitions found by a brace matcher on the token stream. Names ORIG does not define fall back to the GoK working tree (hw1_source=GoK-HEAD). Cataclysm side: ghidra/exports/cataclysm_gog_r6 decompiled.c body (comments stripped), call_graph.csv callees, strings.csv xrefs. Target set: binary-map class hw1:* (symbols_round1-5 notes, then the audited r2-r5 proposal sets) plus CET entries with an hw1_equivalent whose name is current (the docs/binary-map.md R5 rule, 4,426 functions). Features: game-callee sets by canonical HW1 name (HomeworldSDL names mapped through ORIG macro aliases, e.g. clRemoveShipFromSelection -> clRemoveTargetFromSelection); a dropped callee whose own callees appear instead, or a small one from the same unit, counts as inlined and its strings/fields/constants are expected in the caller; C++ member calls, thunk targets and tail calls named in the body count; the map's cat_<hw1name> spellings map back; library/CRT callees compared separately (soft); string literals of >= 4 chars incl. char[] globals (an untyped string behind a DAT_ reference is excused; AI move-name strings \naim* are one header change); struct fields (-> and .) against every identifier in Relic's tree; named globals from symbols.csv; distinctive integer constants (not -2..16, not masks/powers of two); float constants; for/while loop counts; switch/case counts; parameter count; body size vs the HW1 file's median log(bytes/tokens). Hard deltas: game callee added or dropped (not inlined), HW1 callee absent from Cataclysm, string added or dropped, struct field HW1 never names, parameter count from an evidence-named prototype, argument-array calling convention, body > 2.7x larger with more branches. IDENTICAL = no hard delta (soft deviations only); REWRITTEN = a hard delta, under half of HW1's callees+strings survive, and weighted score < 0.4 or (>= 4 game callees, callee Jaccard < 0.25, string Jaccard < 0.34); else MODIFIED. 'change' is the automatic delta list unless reviewed=true (hand review of both bodies, recorded in ghidra/delta_map_review.json, which also holds the write-up's findings under _notes).
hw1_source: Relic HW1 source at gardens-of-kadesh root commit ad1bb82ca3c62dcc8be9d35f2e836d0bb7cf7caa (ORIG); GoK working tree only where ORIG has no definition (hw1_source=GoK-HEAD)
